title: Elijah Fed by Ravens
reflectionQuestion: God sent birds to bring Elijah food, every morning and every evening. When you sit down to eat, what are some of the good things you are thankful for?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Elijah, secondary/short-only). WONDER/provision/comfort. Distinct Elijah scene from 1842 Carmel (fire) + 1839 whisper -- no fire, no contest, no mountain; this is God quietly providing by the brook. The drought/famine is kept gentle ('a long, dry time... food became hard to find') with no suffering shown -- focus is God's care. Indelible image = ravens (big black birds) carrying bread in their beaks, morning and evening. Routes a worried / 'will there be enough' child to trust + thankfulness. 'God' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_JAMES_HUSKY (wise elder, calm) -- fits the quiet provision tone; re-voiced 2026-06-22 from the now-banned ELIJAH_SAGE.
